subject: Report group description entry
notes: SR7 has two halves. The first (the entry-name format shall be specified when the data-name is referenced in a GENERATE statement, a USE BEFORE REPORTING statement, as a qualifier for a SUM counter, in the UPON phrase of the SUM clause, or as an operand in a SUM clause) holds by construction: those references resolve by name through ReportGroupResolution and the SUM resolvers, and an unnamed entry has no name to resolve. The second (the data-name shall not be referenced in any other way) is enforced as its own rule: a reference that reaches an unidentified-name report AND names a report section entry (DataBinder.ReportEntriesNamed - the entry's real qualification, the report-name last, the GLOBAL reports of containers included) draws COBOL5092 citing 13.8.6.2.3 and 13.15.3 SR7 instead of the false COBOL1639 'not defined', from a procedure division statement, a FILE STATUS / RELATIVE KEY / LINAGE / APPLY COMMIT clause, and an OCCURS DEPENDING ON of another section. A sum counter (13.8.6.2.3 1) and a DETAIL group named by GENERATE (13.8.6.2.3 2) never reach it. Closed by kb/Work PB1046.
